body:
Impact: the PR body is the primary published scope declaration, and this repo's own invariant (stated in the body and receipts) is that no declared omitted-input scope may be replaced by passing deterministic checks. The body's enumeration matches CodeRabbit's captured fcee-era 14-file list exactly and the fcee-era head SHA, while input-manifest.json and diff_stat prove 20 changed files at head fe7c3075 — including the six JSONs that carry the first-round MiMo finding and its fix proof, precisely the evidence a new reviewer needs. A reviewer trusting the description would under-scope this review by 6 inputs.

Evidence: pr-context.md body (head declaration, "The14actual changed inputs", "owned14paths") vs input-manifest.json head_sha fe7c3075...e and deterministic diff_stat (20 files: 4 markdown + ledger.edn + receipts.edn + session ledger.md + 13 JSONs); receipts.edn line 42 (added) decision: "Prepared old14input brief remains historical and unsent; regenerate complete new-head scope before request after fresh cooldown/pending read". Machine gates are unaffected (they use the manifest), which is why this is non-blocking.

Smallest fix: regenerate the PR description for fe7c3075 — correct the head SHA, the changed-input count to 20 (13 JSONs), and the receipt/reflection deltas to 4 rows / 32 lines — before the next round of review requests.
